pictures.author: Dario Alpern
pictures.observations: Close westward street-side picture: two differently angled pale rectangular shafts with punched window grids, dark glazed inner ends and stepped upper storeys, pale louvered crowns, narrow high bridge plus two visible lower bridges. Separate rounded foreground tower, cranes, traffic and signs excluded.

pictures.author: Roberto Fiadone
pictures.observations: Opposite reserve-side view corroborates separated angled twin shafts, darker upper glazing, flat pale crowns and high connection. Fine lower connector heights/hidden reverse openings cannot be surveyed from these perspective views.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific connected El Faro compound: both individually angled mapped 160m shafts, pale punched-window concrete frames, dark glazed inner strips/stepped upper storeys, closed roofs and pale louvered crowns, mapped high connector and two picture-led intermediate bridges, bounded entry canopies. Four existing shared concrete/window-grid/paint/membrane graphs. No neighboring high-rises, whole-block podium, ground-covering platform, copied signs/photo atlas, furnished interiors or construction cranes.
